smartCart.title: Smart Shopping Cart POS
smartCart.desc: An executable point-of-sale application built in VB with the WPF framework, running on Raspberry Pi OS and synchronised to the cloud. Shoppers scan any RFID-tagged product at the cart-mounted reader and see product code, description, unit price, quantity and running total in real time. A built-in aisle locator helps find items, checkout runs through an auto-generated QR code, and the receipt is emailed automatically.

ar.title: AR Application for the Faculty of Science
ar.tagline: The idea that predicted the career.
ar.desc: Point a phone or tablet at a student project in the laboratory and the application recognises it, then overlays the information a printed label never fits. Touch a part of the AR object and that component highlights and explains itself.
interactive: Select a component to highlight it
ar.accuracy: This is a university concept project. It was not commercially deployed and has not been used in an industrial environment. Engineering applications are presented as potential future uses.
